Ana (CISO): FYI team  security advisory: were enforcing org MFA and tightening long-lived credential usage. Required actions below.
Marco (VP Eng): timeline?
Ana (CISO): MFA enforcement begins 2026-04-20. Audit and rotate any service tokens/deploy keys older than 60 days by 2026-04-30.
Tess K: audit tool?
Ana (CISO): Use the token-audit tool in infra tools: `./token-audit --age 60 --org redwood`. We'll publish CSVs per team.
DevOps Bot: scheduled: token-audit-runner dry-run 2026-04-09T02:00:00Z; results posted in #eng-security.
Ravi P: external partners with legacy keys?
Ana (CISO): Submit exception tickets to security-exceptions with end date and compensating controls; default window 21 days.
Marco (VP Eng): Can platform help migrate CI -> OIDC?
Ana (CISO): Yes, docs and GitHub Actions OIDC examples in internal docs; platform-eng available for assistance.
DevOps Bot: reminder queued: 2026-04-13 09:00 UTC  leads who haven't acknowledged.
Ana (CISO): Please ack in this thread once you've scheduled rotations. Escalate blockers to me or platform-eng. :lock:
Tess K: Acked, will run audit and tag owners.
Ravi P: Acked, starting inventory.
